question_text: A senator proposes a resolution declaring that the Philippines renounces war as an instrument of national policy, except when used for self-defense. Which article and section of the 1987 Constitution contains this principle?

options.text: Article II, Section 2: The Philippines renounces war as an instrument of national policy, adopts the generally accepted principles of international law as part of the law of the land, and adheres to the policy of peace, equality, justice, freedom, cooperation, and amity with all nations.
Article VI, Section 23: The Congress shall have the power to declare the existence of a state of war.
Article VII, Section 18: The President shall be the Commander-in-Chief of all armed forces.
Article VIII, Section 1: The judicial power shall be vested in the Supreme Court and lower courts.
